Moteris iš Ispanijos.
A woman from Spain.
We talked with the Spanish woman about work.

Toks, kuris nebegyvena su savo žmona ar vyru.

Tai, kaip žmogus atrodo.
The way a person looks.
The photograph shows his real appearance.

Vyras iš Japonijos.
A man from Japan.

The years when a person is still not old.
Grandmother tells about her youth.

White sour food from milk.
For breakfast I eat yogurt with jam.

Sėdėti ant arklio ir važiuoti.
To sit on a horse and travel.

On a white horse rides a young girl.

Garsiai rodyti, kad tau labai linksma: cha cha cha!

The children laugh in the yard.

A person who works on a ship.

A very warm coat for winter from an animal's skin.
In winter grandmother wears a fur coat.

An animal's hair on the body; warm and soft.
The fox has brown fur.

Ta pusė, kur yra širdis; ne dešinė.
That side where the heart is; not the right.
The school is on the left side.

Šiltas saldus rudas pienas su šokoladu.
Warm sweet brown milk with chocolate.
The children drink cocoa with cake.

A narrow long thing which a man wears with a suit and a shirt.

The part of the face between the eyes and the hair.
The girl has a high forehead.

A big farm bird, similar to a very big hen.
For Christmas we bake a turkey.

A sheet on which are all the days of the year.
The teacher looks at the calendar.

A small and low mountain.

The doctor has much patience.

A calm place where people visit the graves of dead grandparents and parents.
During the holidays we go to the cemetery.

Unpleasant, like strong coffee without sugar; not sweet.
This tea is bitter.

The children play with the tomcat.

A small domestic animal with whiskers; she is a female and catches mice.
Cats like to lie on the window.

A thing on the face at a party or in the hospital.

Ne toks kaip visada; ne paprastas.
Not such as always; not ordinary.

Žmogus, kuris važiuoja autobusu ar traukiniu.
A person who travels by bus or by train.

Not many; when there are few things, but not one.

Drabužis kojoms; ne sijonas.
A garment for the legs; not a skirt.
In the shop I bought blue trousers.

Imti sunkų daiktą ir dėti jį aukštai.
To take a heavy thing and put it high.
Father lifts a heavy suitcase.

Duona, kurios dar nepjaustėme; vienas didelis gabalas.
Bread that we have not yet cut; one big piece.

Šiltas drabužis ant galvos žiemą.
A warm garment on the head in winter.
The boy forgot the cap at home.

Toks, kuris eilėje yra po trylikto.

Today is the fourteenth day of the month.

On Thursday we go to the swimming pool.

Toks, kuris eilėje stovi po trečio.
One that in a row stands after the third.
We live on the fourth floor.

Mėsa, iš kurios daro kumpį ir dešrą.
Meat from which they make ham and sausage.
Today we eat pork with cabbage.

Storas naminis gyvūnas su trumpomis kojomis ir uodega.
A fat farm animal with short legs and a tail.
On the farm we saw big pigs.

Didelis daiktas, kuriame nešame vandenį.
A big thing in which we carry water.
She pours water into the bucket.
